headline: Robinsons Land Swaps P20.16 Billion Mall Asset Into REIT Unit
summary: Robinsons Land Corp. agreed to infuse its largest shopping mall into its real estate investment trust unit, RL Commercial REIT, through a P20.16 billion property-for-share transaction.
why: Robinsons Land Corp. is a major property developer in the Philippines, operating commercial malls, office towers, and hotels.

impacts.name: Robinsons Land Corp.
impacts.why: Asset infusion into REIT expands dividend yield and recurring fee structures.
